records.subtitle_id: Dipercaya oleh 50+ Laboratorium Klinis & Rumah Sakit di Seluruh Indonesia
records.subtitle_en: Trusted by 50+ Clinical Laboratories & Hospitals Across Indonesia

records.title_id: Di Diagnova, Kami Mengubah Data Diagnostik Menjadi Intelijen Klinis, Memperkuat Laboratorium Menghasilkan Keputusan Medis yang Presisi.
records.title_en: At Diagnova, We Transform Diagnostic Data Into Clinical Intelligence, Empowering Laboratories To Make Precise Medical Decisions.
records.subtitle_id: Lebih dari sekadar LIS konvensional, Diagnova adalah ekosistem cerdas yang menghubungkan tenaga medis, instrumen laboratorium, dan alur kerja klinis. Kami membantu laboratorium modern melangkah dari sekadar mengelola data menuju penyajian wawasan klinis yang akurat dan dapat ditindaklanjuti.
records.subtitle_en: More than a traditional LIS, Diagnova is an intelligent ecosystem connecting clinicians, instruments, and laboratory workflows. We empower modern laboratories to move beyond managing data to delivering clear, actionable clinical insights.

records.subtitle_id: Bandingkan hambatan LIS konvensional dengan lonjakan efisiensi dan akurasi klinis bersama ekosistem cerdas Diagnova.
records.subtitle_en: Compare the constraints of legacy LIS against the surge in clinical efficiency and diagnostic accuracy powered by Diagnova.

records.subtitle_id: Setiap tabung spesimen bergerak melalui ekosistem digital terintegrasi dari meja registrasi hingga laporan dokter.
records.subtitle_en: Every specimen moves through a secure digital lifecycle from registration counter to clinical report.

steps.descriptionEn: Each sample tube receives a unique barcode, eliminating misidentification and lost specimens.
steps.descriptionId: Setiap tabung spesimen menerima barcode unik, memastikan tidak ada sampel tertukar di laboratorium.

steps.descriptionEn: Raw test values flow directly from analyzers into the digital patient record without manual transcription.
steps.descriptionId: Setelah diproses analyzer, Diagnova menyimpan seluruh angka hasil uji secara langsung tanpa ketik ulang manual.

steps.descriptionEn: Sudden parameter shifts trigger immediate real-time alerts for pathologists and attending doctors.
steps.descriptionId: Jika terdeteksi nilai kritis atau deviasi drastis, sistem otomatis memicu peringatan seketika bagi dokter dan analis.

steps.descriptionEn: Signed reports synchronize instantly to the hospital EHR and outpatient patient portal.
steps.descriptionId: Hasil laboratorium yang telah tervalidasi langsung terkirim ke dokter dan tersinkronisasi mulus ke RME rumah sakit.

records.title_id: Dibangun untuk Keandalan Kelas Rumah Sakit
records.subtitle_id: Arsitektur cloud native Diagnova dirancang dengan standar keamanan data medis tertinggi, integrasi instrumen tak terbatas, dan asisten AI terdepan.
records.subtitle_en: Diagnova cloud-native architecture is built with the highest medical data standards, limitless analyzer integrations, and cutting-edge clinical AI.

cards.descriptionEn: Strict barcode identification and direct analyzer interfacing cut Turnaround Time (TAT) by up to 70% by eliminating manual data entry.
cards.descriptionId: Identifikasi kode batang yang ketat dan koneksi alat dua arah memangkas Turnaround Time (TAT) hingga 70% dengan mengeliminasi entri data manual.

cards.descriptionEn: Natively bridges with HIS, EMR, and is SATUSEHAT ready. Universally compatible with over 500 medical instruments.
cards.descriptionId: Terhubung secara asli dengan SIMRS, RME, dan siap SATUSEHAT. Kompatibel secara universal dengan lebih dari 500 instrumen medis.

cards.descriptionEn: Nova AI detects patterns, provides early warnings, and simplifies complex numbers. Treatment decisions remain 100% with the doctor.
cards.descriptionId: Nova AI mendeteksi pola, memberikan peringatan dini, dan menyederhanakan angka diagnostik kompleks. Keputusan medis tetap 100% di tangan dokter.

records.subtitle_id: Hadirkan keandalan tinggi, kecepatan analisis, dan presisi klinis bagi institusi kesehatan Anda hari ini.
records.subtitle_en: Bring high reliability, speed, and precision to your healthcare institution today.

records.title_id: Kisah Nyata dari Mitra Laboratorium Kami
records.title_en: Real Stories Shared by Our Customers
records.subtitle_id: Dengarkan langsung dari kepala laboratorium, dokter patologi klinik, dan direktur rumah sakit yang mengandalkan Diagnova setiap hari untuk mempercepat TAT dan memastikan akurasi diagnostik.
records.subtitle_en: Hear directly from laboratory directors, clinical pathologists, and hospital executives who rely on Diagnova daily to streamline turnaround times and ensure diagnostic precision.

records.subtitle_id: Sistem Informasi Laboratorium generasi baru yang menghubungkan instrumen medis secara otomatis dengan para klinisi. Mengubah data diagnostik kompleks menjadi keputusan medis yang cepat, akurat, dan transparan.
records.subtitle_en: A next-generation Laboratory Information System autonomously connecting medical instruments with clinicians. Transforming complex diagnostic data into fast, accurate, and actionable medical decisions.

records.title_id: Dari Hasil Uji Mentah Menjadi Keputusan Klinis
records.title_en: From Raw Lab Results To Clinical Intelligence
records.subtitle_id: Sistem Informasi Laboratorium generasi baru yang menghubungkan instrumen medis secara otomatis dengan para klinisi.
records.subtitle_en: A next-generation Laboratory Information System autonomously connecting medical instruments with clinicians.

records.subtitle_id: Bridging instan dua arah dengan SATUSEHAT Kemenkes dan ratusan jenis analyzer rumah sakit.
records.subtitle_en: Instant bi-directional bridging with SATUSEHAT and hundreds of hospital laboratory instruments.

records.conventional_desc_id: Pengetikan angka hasil secara manual lambat dan memperbesar risiko salah transkripsi.
records.conventional_desc_en: Typing test values manually is slow and raises risk of transcript error.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Koneksi instrumen langsung dan verifikasi otomatis memangkas Turnaround Time (TAT) hingga 70%.
records.diagnova_desc_en: Direct device interfacing and automatic verification cuts Turnaround Time (TAT) by up to 70%.

records.conventional_desc_id: Komunikasi alat serial rentan drop, memicu antrean sampel dan risiko data hilang.
records.conventional_desc_en: Serial connections frequently disconnect, creating sample bottlenecks and data loss.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Protokol HL7/ASTM dengan buffer luring (offline buffer), data tetap aman saat jaringan rumah sakit terganggu.
records.diagnova_desc_en: HL7/ASTM protocol with offline buffer keeps records safe even during network outages.

records.conventional_desc_id: Hasil abnormal lambat disadari dokter karena ketiadaan notifikasi otomatis seketika.
records.conventional_desc_en: Abnormal values go unnoticed until manual review, delaying urgent treatment.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Peringatan dini nilai kritis dan delta check instan, membantu dokter merespons kegawatdaruratan lebih cepat.
records.diagnova_desc_en: Instant critical alerts and delta checks empower physicians to respond rapidly to emergencies.

records.conventional_desc_id: Riwayat koreksi tidak terlacak rapi, menyulitkan akreditasi KARS dan ISO 15189.
records.conventional_desc_en: Change history lacks cryptographic certainty, complicating accreditation audits.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Setiap modifikasi hasil terekam dengan timestamp, identitas operator, dan nilai sebelumnya siap akreditasi.
records.diagnova_desc_en: Every edit logs operator identity, timestamp, and previous values, ready for ISO 15189.

records.conventional_desc_id: Server lokal rentan rusak fisik, backup manual jarang dilakukan, dan sulit diekspansi.
records.conventional_desc_en: Local servers are prone to hardware failure, manual backups, and rigid limits.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Mendukung multi-cabang tanpa batas dengan backup otomatis dan enkripsi data end-to-end.
records.diagnova_desc_en: Multi-branch scalability with automated geo-redundant backups and end-to-end encryption.

records.conventional_desc_id: Entri ganda berulang memicu salah identifikasi spesimen dan membuang waktu klinis.
records.conventional_desc_en: Duplicate data entry causes specimen misidentification and slows patient onboarding.
records.diagnova_desc_id: Sinkronisasi otomatis dengan SIMRS, RME, dan terhubung resmi ke SATUSEHAT Kemenkes tanpa ketik ulang.
records.diagnova_desc_en: Automated synchronization with EHR, HIS, and SATUSEHAT without repetitive re-typing.

records.name: dr. Arif Kurniawan, MARS
records.quote_id: Platform Diagnova sangat mudah diimplementasikan dan langsung memberikan dampak operasional. Dalam hitungan minggu, koordinasi antara dokter spesialis dan analis lab menjadi jauh lebih sinkron dan presisi.
records.quote_en: Diagnova was exceptionally fast to deploy and delivered immediate operational impact. Within weeks, synchronization between attending specialists and laboratory analysts reached peak precision.

records.name: Maya Indrawati, S.Tr.AK
records.quote_id: Bagi tim teknisi analis, antarmukanya luar biasa intuitif. Fitur auto-verification dan bridging SATUSEHAT bekerja di latar belakang tanpa lag, menghemat berjam-jam kerja setiap shift malam.
records.quote_en: For medical analysts, the UI is remarkably intuitive. Auto-verification and SATUSEHAT bridging work seamlessly in the background without lag, saving countless hours on night shifts.

records.name: dr. Budi Santoso, Sp.A
records.quote_id: Hasil laboratorium CITO dan peringatan nilai kritis kini terkirim otomatis ke perangkat tablet saat visit pasien. Kecepatan ini sangat berharga dalam menyelamatkan pasien kegawatdaruratan anak.
records.quote_en: STAT lab results and critical alerts now appear automatically on our mobile tablets during rounds. This speed is invaluable when treating urgent pediatric intensive care cases.

records.name: dr. Rina Puspitasari, Sp.PK
records.quote_id: Integrasi dua arah Diagnova dengan analyzer otomatis memangkas waktu entri manual hingga 75%. Risiko tertukar sampel kini nol dengan verifikasi barcode cerdas dan alert delta check instan.
records.quote_en: Diagnova's bi-directional analyzer interfacing eliminated 75% of manual entry time. Sample mix-ups dropped to zero thanks to intelligent barcode verification and immediate delta alerts.
